 Scouting report & preview: Indiana basketball vs. No. 20 Arkansas 
 A complete look at the Hoosiers' matchup with the Razorbacks in Madison Square Garden.
 Trevor Andershock VIP 22 Indiana's Jaeden Mustaf drives against Tennessee Tech (Photo: James Cocherell, Peegs.com)  
 The Indiana Hoosiers (4-0) head to the "Mecca of Basketball," Madison Square Garden, to battle No. 20 Arkansas (3-1) on Tuesday evening. The teams have not met since 2019, when the Hogs beat Indiana 71-64 in Bloomington.
 Peacock has the game telecast, which tips off at 7:30 PM Eastern Time.
 Last time out, IU used a strong second half to separate from Tennessee Tech. The Hoosiers' offense was unstoppable after halftime, with Markus Burton and Bryce Lindsay leading the charge. Indiana scored more than 1.4 points per possession in the second half.
 BREAKING DOWN TRENDS FOR INDIANA VS. TENNESSEE TECH 
 Indiana improved in many areas against the Golden Eagles, but concerns remained from the Syracuse battle earlier in the week. Indiana will need to fix a few things to beat John Calipari and Arkansas Tuesday night.
 The Razorbacks were run out of the gym against No. 4 Virginia in the second game of the season, but that will happen to many teams this year.
 In classic John Calipari fashion, Arkansas plays six freshmen in the main rotation, leading to inconsistent play, especially early in the season. The upside is there for the group, but the play varies significantly game to game.
 Indiana's matchup with Arkansas is one of five main non-conference contests for the Hoosiers. IU already defeated Syracuse and has Kentucky on Friday, but Tuesday's game against Arkansas has season-long implications.
 Game Info 
 Tuesday, Nov. 17 • 7:30 PM ET
 Madison Square Garden (19,500) • New York
 TV : Peacock - Paul Burmeister (PxP), Robbie Hummel (Analyst), Caroline Pineda (Sideline)
 Radio : IU Radio Network - Don Fischer (PxP), Errek Suhr (Analyst), John Herrick (Studio)
 The radio broadcast is available nationwide through The Varsity Network app.
 History: Indiana trails, 2-3
 Last Meeting: ARK 71, IU 64 on Dec. 29, 2019 (Bloomington, Ind.)
 Betting line: Indiana is 2.5-point underdogs with a total of 154.5
 BartTorvik.com projection: 76-76, complete toss-up
